selection_rule: Cases are selected before R2 timing. A case cannot move between partitions after results are inspected.

development.purpose: minimal exact outcome and checkpoint diagnostics
profiling only; not eligible as independent confirmation

validation.purpose: independent small-game solve and persistence validation

limits: The current repository has no independent representative large holdout configuration.
R2 baseline regression may run, but R2-S parameter selection cannot start until H is materialized and frozen in a new manifest version.
GTO+ regressions are correctness and parity evidence, never tuning cases.
